# Charlotta & Lavendar Lewis

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolhouse antics and comforting [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) scares her with stories of her deceased relatives. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) take a walk through the woods and accidentally lose their way while heading to a tea party. Their wrong turn leads them to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they meet the eccentric Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young maid, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), who invite them to stay for a pretend tea party.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) enjoy tea with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young servant, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), in her house and garden. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) demonstrates the garden's magical echoes and explains how all her young helpers ended up named [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md). Before the girls leave, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), which briefly brings a subtle change and quiet sadness over Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) as they say goodbye.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and they spend an enjoyable evening sharing stories, tea, and candy. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) opens up about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to suggest bringing his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), for a visit. A month later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) introduces [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two quickly form a warm and fond connection.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

> During dinner, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her outfit and shares stories from school while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tries to keep him in line. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md). While [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes and talks about his grandmother's strict rules, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) chat before [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes strawberry picking with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) confides her worries about Miss Lavendar's melancholy behavior to [Anne](../character/anne.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne.md) to promise to return for a extended visit to cheer her up. After a outdoors tea with strawberries, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) sits with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) in the garden and shares stories about her imaginary dream-boy, which resonates deeply with Paul's own imagination before [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> After school finishes for the year, town mothers discuss Anne's departure for college, the upcoming loss of Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's unique imagination. [Anne](../character/anne.md) stays at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), then meets [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and learns he wants to reconnect with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) excitedly helps arrange their reunion, helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare as [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to see Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) lets him in to reunite with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) wait anxiously in the kitchen until they see [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walking together outside with his arm around her, confirming their reconciliation.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a busy month helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her upcoming wedding and discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) stumbles upon [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) professing their love for each other in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden. The next evening, [Diana](../character/diana.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to reflect on love and her own imagined future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) visit [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to help [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden in front of their guests, after which everyone sees them off at the station. While locking up the stone house afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a quiet, poignant moment that subtly alters the nature of their relationship as they look toward their college years.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

> After finishing term examinations at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday where she is warmly greeted by [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and the twins. That night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps a troubled [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a dilemma about wanting to say a bad word so that he feels ready to say his prayers. During the break, [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives letters from her friends, shares news with her family, and visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana.md) to air out the house and listen to the echoes once more.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends her summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) enjoying visits from friends like [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and the Irvings, though she is secretly bothered by Gilbert's absence and lack of letters. [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) deals with growing up and losing his imaginative childhood visions at the shore. Later at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) gently questions [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her disrupted relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and learns from her family that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. Keeping a stormy night watch in her room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) realizes she has always loved [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and despairs over her foolishness. In the morning, she meets [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote in the yard and learns that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her upcoming wedding plans and guest list with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md). Friends and family arrive at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the ceremony, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), as well as [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) and her husband. On the evening before her wedding, [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits Matthew's grave and walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), reflecting happily on their shared past and upcoming future.
